description: This file defines the SigningResult class used for managing cryptographic signing results within the AWS CRT PHP SDK. It extends NativeResource and provides methods for creation, cleanup, and applying the signing result to an HTTP request.

classes.name: SigningResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a cryptographic signing operation, managing native resource lifecycle and providing functionality to apply signing results to HTTP requests.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SigningResult object with a native resource pointer and acquires the resource.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Releases the native resource when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: fromNative
methods.description: Creates a new SigningResult instance from a native pointer.

methods.name: applyToHttpRequest
methods.description: Applies the signing result to a given HTTP request and updates the request object from its native blob.
